headline: Best Handiwork Pal in Palworld
title: Best Handiwork Pal in Palworld | Solenne | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Handiwork Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Solenne, with level eight Handiwork. Solenne is an endgame World Tree Pal, so most players run Anubis at the workbench until then. The best alternative is Anubis, with level six Handiwork and great Mining. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Handiwork at your base? Comment below!
description: The best Handiwork Pal in Palworld 1.0 is Solenne (level 8 Handiwork). Alternative: Anubis (level 6 Handiwork and great Mining). Condensing to 4 stars raises every work suitability by 1.
